'''Red Five''' was the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of the fifth member of Red Squadron. There were a number of [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] with this name, and several [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] went by the call sign Red Five.

==History==
A [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Delta-7 ''Aethersprite''-class light interceptor]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] flew as "Red Five" with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Red Squadron (Galactic Republic)/Legends|Red Squadron]] under [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mavra Zane]] in [[Rebellion on Felucia|pursuit]] of [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] leader [[Shu Mai/Legends|Shu Mai]] over [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]].<ref name="Kinect" />

An unknown [[Clone trooper pilot/Legends|clone trooper pilot]] went by the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] of Red Five. He was killed during a mission to [[Tythe/Legends|Tythe]] in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].

[[File:Red_Five_TCG.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Luke Skywalker flying as Red Five during the Battle of Yavin.]]
At the climax of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] flew an [[Eta-2 Actis-class interceptor/Legends|Eta-2 ''Actis''-class interceptor]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> under the designation Red Five.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|87|Red Five (1)}}</ref>

[[Rebel pilot/Legends|Rebel pilot]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] flew a [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]] as Red Five in the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="ANH" /> and on a [[Battle of Lubang Minor (Galactic Civil War)|mission]] to [[Lubang Minor]] [[0 ABY/Legends|approximately seven months later]].<ref name="E:GS">[[Empire 27|''Empire'' 27]]</ref> After the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]], Skywalker resumed his use of the call sign in a [[Battle of Tandankin|battle]] at [[Tandankin]].<ref name="XWRSS">''[[X-Wing Rogue Squadron Special]]''</ref>

Due to a lack of personnel, the [[Wookiee/Legends|wookiee]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] was assigned to Red Squadron and took on the call sign during a [[reconnaissance mission to Kamino]].<ref name="RF:F">''[[Rebel Force: Firefight]]''</ref>

[[Grizz Frix/Legends|Grizz Frix]] flew as Red Five at the Battle of Endor,<ref name="Hasbro">{{HasbroCite|set=Star Wars: Shadows of the Dark Side|pack=(Toys R Us Exclusive) Battle Over Endor (2 of 2)|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/tvcexbattleoverendor2.asp}}</ref> during which he was killed in the explosion of his X-wing [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref>

Shortly after the Alliance's victory at [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] using the call sign Red Five flew with the Rebel [[Bakura task force]] during the [[Bakura/Legends|planet's]] [[Invasion of Bakura|invasion]] by the [[Ssi-ruuvi Imperium]]. "Red Five" led an element of Red Squadron tasked initially with protecting the [[Quasar Fire-class cruiser-carrier/Legends|''Quasar Fire''-class bulk cruiser]] ''[[Flurry]]'', before being reassigned to the defense of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue One]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].<ref name="TAB">''[[The Truce at Bakura]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|novelization]] of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars:'' Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] identified as [[Davish Krail/Legends|"Pops"]] uses the call sign Red Five,<ref name="ANHn">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref> while the film gives him the call sign [[Gold Five/Legends|Gold Five]].<ref name="ANH" />

Red5 was used as a cheat code in ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]'' which granted the player all weapons and full ammunition.

Red Five is the inspiration for the call sign of the parodic character [[Wikipedia:Pink Five|''Pink Five'']].
